title: Automatically Reference All Tipper Axes Using Operator Station HMI (RESET → AUTO REF → AUTO → CYCLE START)
summary: Use the operator station HMI to run automatic axis referencing for all tipper axes. Confirm referencing completion by watching the 'R' icons turn green, then press AUTO and CYCLE START to resume operation.
when_to_use: Use when tipper axes need re-commissioning/initialization and you need to automatically reference all tipper axes from the operator station HMI, then restart operation.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Executes the HMI button sequence (RESET → AUTO REF → AUTO → CYCLE START) and verifies referencing completion via the 'R' icons turning green.

visual_references.description: Operator station HMI screen showing the automatic referencing controls (RESET / AUTO REF) and the 'R' icons behavior, plus AUTO and CYCLE START context within the maintenance procedure section.

steps.title: Press RESET on the operator station HMI
steps.purpose: Initiate the automatic referencing sequence for all tipper axes.
steps.instruction: On the operator station HMI, press RESET.
steps.expected_result: The automatic referencing sequence is initiated (next step AUTO REF becomes the action to reference all tipper axes).
steps.healthy_condition: RESET is successfully pressed and you proceed to AUTO REF for referencing.
steps.failure_condition: RESET does not initiate the referencing workflow (e.g., you cannot proceed to a referencing state where 'R' icons will change).

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: Press RESET; Press AUTO REF to reference all of the axes of the tippers.

steps.title: Press AUTO REF to reference all tipper axes
steps.purpose: Start automatic referencing for all tipper axes.
steps.instruction: Press AUTO REF to reference all of the axes of the tippers.
steps.expected_result: Referencing begins and the 'R' icons will indicate progress.
steps.healthy_condition: The 'R' icons are present and begin transitioning as referencing runs.
steps.failure_condition: Referencing does not start or the 'R' icons do not progress toward green completion.

actions.label: Press AUTO REF
actions.exact_action: Press AUTO REF to reference all of the axes of the tippers.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the 'R' icons do not turn green, stop and escalate for support rather than proceeding to AUTO/CYCLE START.

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: Press AUTO REF to reference all of the axes of the tippers. The 'R' icons will turn green when referencing is completed.

steps.title: Verify referencing completion by watching 'R' icons turn green
steps.purpose: Confirm that automatic referencing has completed successfully before resuming operation.
steps.instruction: Watch the 'R' icons until they turn green, indicating referencing is completed.
steps.expected_result: All relevant 'R' icons turn green (referencing completed).
steps.healthy_condition: The 'R' icons are green, indicating referencing completion.
steps.failure_condition: One or more 'R' icons do not turn green.

actions.label: Monitor 'R' icons
actions.exact_action: Watch the 'R' icons until they turn green, indicating referencing is completed.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the 'R' icons do not turn green, stop and escalate for support rather than proceeding to AUTO/CYCLE START.

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: The 'R' icons will turn green when referencing is completed.

steps.title: Press AUTO after referencing is completed
steps.purpose: Place the tipper system into AUTO mode after successful referencing.
steps.instruction: When referencing is completed, press AUTO.
steps.expected_result: AUTO is pressed after the 'R' icons are green.
steps.healthy_condition: AUTO is engaged after referencing completion.
steps.failure_condition: AUTO is pressed before referencing completion (i.e., before 'R' icons are green).

actions.label: Press AUTO
actions.exact_action: When referencing is completed, press AUTO.

stop_or_escalate_if: Do not proceed to CYCLE START until the 'R' icons are green.

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: When referencing is completed, press AUTO.

steps.title: Press CYCLE START to restart operation
steps.purpose: Restart the tipper operation cycle after AUTO mode is set.
steps.instruction: Press CYCLE START to restart operation.
steps.expected_result: The operation cycle restarts after AUTO is set.
steps.healthy_condition: CYCLE START is pressed following AUTO, and the system proceeds to restart operation.
steps.failure_condition: CYCLE START does not restart operation after successful referencing and AUTO.

actions.label: Press CYCLE START
actions.exact_action: Press CYCLE START to restart operation.

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: Press CYCLE START to restart operation.

success_criteria: After pressing AUTO REF, the 'R' icons turn green (referencing completed).
After pressing AUTO and CYCLE START, operation restarts.
healthy_conditions: The 'R' icons turn green when referencing is completed.
failure_conditions: The 'R' icons do not turn green after AUTO REF.
escalation_guidance: If the 'R' icons do not turn green, stop and escalate for support rather than proceeding to AUTO/CYCLE START.

screens_or_images.what_to_look_at: Operator station HMI screen showing the RESET and AUTO REF controls and the 'R' icons used to confirm referencing completion; also provides context for AUTO and CYCLE START within the same maintenance procedure section.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: Press RESET; Press AUTO REF to reference all of the axes of the tippers. The 'R' icons will turn green when referencing is completed. When referencing is completed, press AUTO. Press CYCLE START to restart operation.
